GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, took over turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths clear, joined 100m, headed 50m kept on strong late # found 1 better
Jumped Well Went Forward Four Wide to lead 2 Lengths 800m lead 2 Lengths home turn lead 3 Lengths Middle Of Track Straight only picked up final few strides # led/very honest
Jumped Ok , Not Bustled in second half Two Wide 9 Lengths 800m, off heels between runners soon after Straightening Up , Kept Coming under riding and was not far off a minor placing # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped by another runner which shifted out. Had difficulty obtaining clear running during the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd on inside (2.5L from lead) early . Back 1/2L midrace & pushed to quicken on winner's back @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 200m. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped another runner. Rounding the turn near the 1000m was eased when awkwardly placed inside the heels of another runner which shifted in momentarily.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6th 4 Lengths 1000m 6th 6 Lengths 600m 5th 6 Lengths home turn 4th Hooked Out 3 Wide Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # every ch/one paced

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until improving 3 Wide from 500m: Pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 400m & pushed along Six Wide (3L from lead) on ome turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & got within 1/2L of the leader @ 75m. Held ground late. # Had his chance.
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. made some ground # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start was steadied from the heels of another runner which shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 7l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with another rnr. From a  wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Raced keenly in the early  stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd on rail (3L from lead) early . Stayed same until tracking leader on inside @ 600m & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & tried to sprint with winner @ 200m. Tried hard in last 100m but shaded late. # Every Chance

Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover touch Worse than midfield 4 Lengths 800m, came to Middle Of Track and best ground Straightening Up , chased home solidly last 200m but found one better rails # sound chase
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & held up Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Back to rail @ 300m & held up until clear in last 100m. # Held up badly.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was badly held up from the 350m until near the 150m where it was checked from the heels of a runner before being shifted out into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, kept trying and improved a length in straight. (Concussion Plates (Front) FIRST TIME, Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit FIRST TIME, Tongue Control and Lugging Bit OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Travelled keenly middle stages.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m was steadied when carried out onto heels, being buffeted between runners. Travelled keenly in the middle stages. Approaching the finish was tightened and checked when carried in across heels.
